import ctypes
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the result structure
class gsl_sf_result(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function prototype
gsl.gsl_sf_airy_zero_Ai_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_result)]
gsl.gsl_sf_airy_zero_Ai_e.restype = ctypes.c_int


def airy_zero_ai(n):
    if n < 1:
        raise ValueError('n must be greater than or equal to 1')
    result = gsl_sf_result()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_airy_zero_Ai_e(n, ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('Error in GSL function call')
    return result.val
